arguments.name: routeCode
arguments.description:
Route code to search for (e.g., "000001"). Searches by RT_ID (exact match).
Example: "000003"

raw.name: routeCode
raw.description:
Route code to search for (e.g., "000001"). Searches by RT_ID (exact match).
Example: "000003"

arguments.name: routeName
arguments.description:
Route name (or partial name) to search for (e.g., "Expressway", "Central"). Searches by RT_NAME and supports partial match.
Example: "Express"

raw.name: routeName
raw.description:
Route name (or partial name) to search for (e.g., "Expressway", "Central"). Searches by RT_NAME and supports partial match.
Example: "Express"

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing routes, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list".
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing routes, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list".
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

arguments.name: pageNumber
arguments.description: Specific page number to fetch when not auto-fetching all pages. Default = "1".

raw.name: pageNumber
raw.description: Specific page number to fetch when not auto-fetching all pages. Default = "1".

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Number of records per page to request from grid. Server may cap this. Default = "100".

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Number of records per page to request from grid. Server may cap this. Default = "100".

arguments.name: autoFetchAllPages
arguments.description: Controls whether transformer automatically loops through all pages. Defaults to true when returnAll is used.

raw.name: autoFetchAllPages
raw.description: Controls whether transformer automatically loops through all pages. Defaults to true when returnAll is used.

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety limit to prevent infinite paging loops. Default "50".

raw.name: maxPages
raw.description: Safety limit to prevent infinite paging loops. Default "50".
